scope: Use the approved line-scoped adaptive tint for Apps labels by default. Explicit saved scopes still take precedence.

checks.command: Compile the native profile resolver and verify the default is line with 15 samples. An explicit letter override remains letter with one sample.

Run the Golden Gate Light Apps popup and Tahoe Light clipboard native integration checks. Both passed. Compare old explicit line with the new default in a 285-app grid. All 25 visible label strings, foreground colors, line counts and geometry matched. The deterministic 600x412 software capture matched byte for byte.

Verify the approved line rendering and final delegate ordering on forward and reverse scroll. The deterministic settled grid matched the unpooled reference at both positions. The maintainer explicitly approved publishing the shown line preset as default.

coverage_limits: Scroll measurements use the isolated Apps fixture. The fullscreen frame-time result applies to the tested opaque 1080p scene.
